verdict.rationale: Jitsu is a Segment-style event pipeline, so handling GDPR/CCPA deletion and suppression requests and forwarding them to destinations is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents no user-deletion or suppression workflow and no forwarding of such requests to connected destinations. Event filtering via Functions, the DPA/SCC, and SOC 2 compliance are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a privacy lead, I can process user deletion and suppression requests (GDPR/CCPA) and have them forwarded to connected destinations
